name: Indian great arc triangulation survey
description: A sustained geodetic enterprise began at Madras and extended triangulation for the measurement and mapping of the Indian subcontinent.

date.basis: Year is the date of the described episode in the cited source, not necessarily the invention or first conception.

events.statement: A meridian measurement began from St Thomas, Madras, with a baseline and subsequent triangulation.

evidence.supports: Dated start at Madras, baseline and subsequent triangulation; name adopted in 1818.
